better.en: On Linux, new automatic AI tasks also wait when memory is tight; work already running continues.
better.pt-BR: No Linux, novas tarefas automáticas das IAs também aguardam quando falta memória; o trabalho em andamento continua.
better.es: En Linux, las nuevas tareas automáticas de IA también esperan si falta memoria; el trabajo en curso continúa.
better.fr: Sous Linux, les nouvelles tâches automatiques des IA attendent aussi si la mémoire manque ; le travail en cours continue.
better.de: Auch unter Linux warten neue automatische KI-Aufgaben bei knappem Arbeitsspeicher; laufende Arbeit geht weiter.

decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-24 | Linux extends automatic-worker memory admission with approximate resident pages from /proc/<pid>/statm times the native page size, checked multiplication and exact owned-process start-time identity checks before and after each query. Shared pages may count per process. Existing thresholds, cancellation, count and quota guards remain; native Unix runtime and real parallel resource cost remain unverified. | AI |
